quotes.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
quotes.author: Will Durant (summarizing Aristotle)

quotes.text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: Drop by drop is the water pot filled. Likewise, the wise man, gathering it little by little, fills himself with good.
quotes.author: Gautama Buddha

quotes.text: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.text: No great thing is created suddenly.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: I'm convinced that about half of what separates the successful entrepreneurs from the non-successful ones is pure perseverance.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: Persistence is very important. You should not give up unless you are forced to give up.
quotes.author: Elon Musk

quotes.text: When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.
quotes.author: Elon Musk

quotes.text: Play iterated games. All the returns in life, whether in wealth, relationships, or knowledge, come from compound interest.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: Things don't have to change the world to be important.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: It's not that I'm so smart, it's just that I stay with problems longer.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.text: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
quotes.author: Winston Churchill

quotes.text: Our greatest weakness lies in giving up. The most certain way to succeed is always to try just one more time.
quotes.author: Thomas Edison

quotes.text: Energy and persistence conquer all things.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: I am a slow walker, but I never walk back.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.text: Life is not easy for any of us. But what of that? We must have perseverance and above all confidence in ourselves.
quotes.author: Marie Curie

quotes.text: That which we persist in doing becomes easier for us to do; not that the nature of the thing itself is changed, but that our power to do is increased.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: Long-term consistency trumps short-term intensity.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.text: Amateurs sit and wait for inspiration, the rest of us just get up and go to work.
quotes.author: Stephen King

quotes.text: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
quotes.author: Mark Twain
